# #723 — Production evaluation plan for vLLM provider status

**Status:** Proposed — pre-registered before ingestion.
**Parent:** ADR-043 (broad rollout permitted; default switch deferred).
**Sub-checks:** #724 (large PDF), #725 (new entity).
**Corpus manifest:** [`vllm-production-eval-corpus.tsv`](./vllm-production-eval-corpus.tsv).
**Generated corpus root:** `docs/acceptance/artifacts/vllm-production-eval/corpus/` (not committed; generated by `generate-corpus.py`).

## Purpose

Close the two Open rows in ADR-043's evidence matrix (large-PDF throughput,
new-entity resolution) and establish production-quality evidence for the
provider-default switch decision. This plan does not change the default provider.

## Pre-registered acceptance thresholds

These thresholds are fixed before the first evaluation ingestion. The acceptance
report must state whether each was met, not whether it was approximately met.

| Metric | Threshold | Type |
|---|---|---|
| Entity precision vs. reviewed sample | ≥90% | Gate |
| Entity recall vs. expected | ≥85% | Gate |
| Relation acceptance rate | ≥50% | Gate |
| Lifecycle regressions | 0 | Hard fail |
| Large-PDF p95 latency (100-page) | Record and compare to timeout | Record only until measured |
| New-entity resolution success rate | Record | Record only until measured |
| #720 recurrence rate | ≤15% | Gate |

## Tenant structure — Configuration A (synthetic)

Three tenant scopes, no production-customer traffic:

- `demo` — existing demo tenant.
- `eval-vllm-a` — synthetic evaluation tenant, seeded/provisioned for this run.
- `eval-vllm-b` — synthetic evaluation tenant, seeded/provisioned for this run.

The evaluation tenants require projection provisioning and an active ontology
before ingestion. The corpus manifest assigns documents to these scopes. The
extended observation is a synthetic load test across the same scopes; it does not
expose production traffic to the unproven provider.

## Corpus

- 25 documents: PDF, EPUB, TXT/Markdown.
- 3 tenant scopes.
- 3 negative controls: `quarterly-report.pdf`, `glossary-negative.txt`,
  `reference-index-negative.txt`.
- 2 large PDFs: 102 and 120 pages, extractable text (not scanned).
- ≥3 new-entity-candidate documents: supply-chain profiles and reports containing
  entities not yet in the canonical graph.
- Corpus revisions and SHA-256 per document are pinned in
  [`vllm-production-eval-corpus.tsv`](./vllm-production-eval-corpus.tsv).
- Repository documents are referenced by repo path; generated documents are
  staged under the generated corpus root and pinned by hash. Large/generated
  files are not committed.

## Sub-check #724 — Large PDF

Concrete definition:

- **Size:** ≥100 pages (primary gate) with extractable text; file size is recorded
  but is not the size gate. Scanned/image-only PDFs are out of scope for this
  check (a different OCR failure mode).
- **Corpus:** `large-final-100p.pdf` (102 pages) and `large-final-120p.pdf`
  (120 pages).
- **Measure:** extraction latency p50/p95, end-to-end convergence time, peak JVM
  heap, peak GPU VRAM, timeout/retry behavior, and extraction quality sampled
  against short documents.
- **Acceptance:** no ingestion timeout without an explicit retry/failure record;
  latency and memory recorded even if no pass/fail threshold is pre-set.

## Sub-check #725 — New entity

Concrete definition:

- A document containing at least one entity not present in the canonical graph.
- **Minimum:** 3 documents, marked `new_entity=yes` in the manifest.
- **Measure:** entity identification, resolution outcome, failure mode, whether
  the entity appears in the searchable index without canonical identity, and
  whether failed resolution causes any lifecycle regression.
- **Acceptance:** an unresolvable new entity is never silently treated as
  canonical and never corrupts the canonical graph.

## Execution

1. Provision the two synthetic evaluation tenants and their ontology/projection.
2. Stage the corpus and verify every SHA-256 against the manifest.
3. Ingest the corpus with `provider=regex`; record the baseline.
4. Ingest the same corpus with `provider=llm`; record per-document metrics.
5. Run #724 and #725 as structured sub-evaluations on their documents.
6. Extend observation to ≥100 documents or one week across the three scopes.
7. Write `docs/acceptance/vllm-production-eval-YYYY-MM-DD.md`.

No provider configuration changes before this plan is merged. The environment
remains on `regex` outside the evaluation; each evaluation run flips to `llm` for
the test ingest and restores `regex` after.

## Per-document metrics

Same structure as the controlled canary, plus:

- extraction latency p50/p95 and end-to-end convergence time;
- peak JVM heap and peak GPU VRAM;
- timeout/retry behavior;
- cost proxy (GPU-seconds and ingestion wall time);
- new-entity resolution outcome;
- #720 recurrence;
- promotion completed/failed and lifecycle regressions.

## Reassessment

After the evaluation completes, reassess ADR-043's evidence matrix. If both Open
rows close and the pre-registered thresholds are met, prepare a **separate**
default-switch ADR. This plan does not authorize the default switch.

## Out of scope

- Changing the production, demo, or staging default provider.
- #720 implementation/fix (separate P3 investigation).
- Non-English documents.
- Scanned/OCR-only PDFs.
- Production-customer traffic.
